title: Breastbone
summary: BREAST'BONE, noun [breast and bone.] The bone of the breast; the sternum. BREAST'-C'ASKET, noun [breast and casket.] One of the largest and longest of the caskets or strings on the middle of the yard

inlines.v: BREAST'BONE, noun [breast and bone.] The bone of the breast; the sternum. BREAST'-C'ASKET, noun [breast and casket.] One of the largest and longest of the caskets or strings on the middle of the yard of a ship.
